content.value: Determine the steady state temperature distribution in a thin plate bounded by (19) the lines x = 0, x =l, y = 0 and y → ∞. Assuming that heat cannot escape from either surface of the plate, the edges x =0 & x=l are kept at a temperature zero and also the lower edge $\scriptstyle y = 0$ is kept at temperature F(x) and the edge $y  \infty$ at temperature zero.
